name: Heatmap Chart
description: A matrix of rounded cells on a five-step water ramp, such as days by hour blocks, with a tooltip per cell and a ramp legend.

props.name: rows
props.description: Short labels down the left, one per row, e.g. days.

props.name: columns
props.description: Short labels along the bottom, one per column, e.g. hour blocks. Crowded labels thin out.

props.name: data
props.description: One array per row with a value per column.

props.name: rowTitles
props.description: Longer row names for the tooltip and the screen-reader table.

props.name: columnTitles
props.description: Longer column names for the tooltip, e.g. "06:00–08:00".

props.name: name
props.description: What the values are, shown in the tooltip and legend. Defaults to the card label.

props.name: colors
props.description: The ramp from the lowest step to the highest. Defaults to five evenly spaced water steps, from a quiet empty cell to brand-strong.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Lower bounds of every step after the first, ascending. Defaults to even, rounded steps up to the largest value.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatLegend
props.description: Writes the step bounds under the ramp legend.

props.name: cellHeight
props.description: Height of each cell in pixels. Cell width follows the card, and cells get shorter when it is narrow.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the ramp legend under the plot.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the value, e.g. "last 7 days".

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the legend under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts note, action, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
